verdict.rationale: Proa documents Suspense boundaries that stream ready chunks out of order so slow data does not block the page, and route loaders with caching through WebContext. That covers suspense-driven loading UI for server data. It does not document a resource primitive, and island signals with seed state are not shown to be wired to loader data as reactive state. Missing for 10: a documented resource/async-signal primitive, evidence that server-loaded data becomes reactive client state, fallback/loading-state API details, hands-on corroboration.
